name: Classification and Shading
definition: Mapping each voxel to a predefined colour and opacity. Simple shading/classification involves a mapping from voxel value x(i,j,k). Sophisticated mappings take into account a lighting model and material interest, involving the voxel x(i,j,k) and its gradient Vx(i,j,k).
summary: Classification and Shading maps volume intensities to colors and opacities, using gradient-based shading to enhance surface appearance while maintaining uniform opacity, unlike boundary-enhanced methods that modulate opacity based on gradient magnitude.
